cards.title: Early Intervention (Birth–3)
cards.desc: Call your local Early Intervention program to start services. Ask for vision and occupational therapy screenings.

cards.title: Vision Therapy & O&M
cards.desc: Orientation & Mobility specialists teach safe movement, cane readiness, and spatial awareness.
cards.action: Ask your pediatrician for a referral.

cards.title: Parent Networks
cards.desc: Connect with parents who have walked this path. Share wins and worries in a kind space.

cards.title: Faith-Based Support
cards.desc: Many churches and ministries offer sensory-friendly nurseries and help for families.
cards.action: Ask local leaders about sensory accommodations.
